metadata.name: GPT Image Capability Packs
metadata.description: Reference-led generation and editing prompt cards designed for iterative commercial workflows, including GPT Image 2.5 production patterns.

packs.title: Product identity lock
packs.prompt: Using the supplied product reference as the source of truth, create a premium campaign visual for [brand]. Preserve the product silhouette, proportions, material finish, label placement, and approved brand colors. Place it in [environment] with [lighting direction]. Change only the supporting scene and composition. Keep [protected details] unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Product geometry matches the reference
Label and color placement remain unchanged
The scene supports the product rather than obscuring it

packs.title: Campaign composition transfer
packs.prompt: Create a new [channel] campaign asset for [brand]. Use the first reference for composition logic only and the second reference for product identity only. Do not copy unapproved text, logos, or people from either source. Build a fresh visual around [campaign message], with [negative-space location] reserved for final copy.
acceptance_criteria: Reference roles are followed independently
No source text or unapproved logo is reproduced
Copy area is clean and usable

packs.title: Background replacement with protected product
packs.prompt: Edit the supplied image. Preserve the product, label, logo placement, shape, camera angle, and shadow direction exactly as shown. Replace only the background with [new environment]. Match the existing lighting temperature and preserve a realistic contact shadow. Do not add props, text, hands, or additional products.
acceptance_criteria: Protected product pixels remain visually unchanged
New environment has coherent perspective
Contact shadow remains believable

packs.title: Single-element commercial correction
packs.prompt: Edit only [target element] in the supplied image. Replace it with [replacement detail] while preserving every other object, facial feature, garment, product surface, lighting cue, and crop. Blend the correction naturally with the existing grain, depth of field, and color grade. Return no extra variants or new text.
acceptance_criteria: Only the target element changes
Retained areas preserve the original composition
Edit has no visible seams or duplicate objects

packs.title: Portrait-to-landscape canvas extension
packs.prompt: Extend the supplied portrait image into a 16:9 composition. Keep the original image content unchanged and positioned on the [left or right] third. Generate only the new canvas area, continuing the existing setting, horizon, lighting, and texture. Reserve the opposite side as calm negative space for a headline. Do not stretch, crop, or duplicate the original subject.
acceptance_criteria: Original image content is retained
New canvas continues the scene naturally
Headline zone stays uncluttered

packs.title: Square-to-vertical social adaptation
packs.prompt: Adapt the supplied square campaign visual to a 4:5 vertical social asset. Retain the hero object, scale, palette, and brand mood. Expand the composition above and below with [supporting scene]. Maintain one clear focal point and leave [copy zone] empty. Do not invent offers, prices, or logo text.
acceptance_criteria: Hero remains dominant after reframe
Added space matches the visual system
No fabricated marketing claims appear

packs.title: Editorial launch tile with verified copy
packs.prompt: Design a 4:5 editorial launch tile for [brand]. Use the exact text below and no other visible words: [approved headline]. Set it as the dominant headline in [type treatment], placed in [placement]. Add [visual subject] as a supporting image, with [accent color] used sparingly. Maintain high contrast and generous margins. A human reviewer will verify spelling and alignment before release.
acceptance_criteria: Visible copy exactly matches approved text
Headline is legible at mobile size
No extra words or pseudo-text appear

packs.title: Thumbnail with constrained text
packs.prompt: Create a 16:9 video thumbnail for [topic]. Use only this exact on-image phrase: [approved phrase]. Place it in a large high-contrast block on the [left or right]. Feature [subject or product] with a clear expression or silhouette on the opposite side. Use a restrained [brand palette] and strong focal separation. Do not include interface screenshots, watermarks, or any extra text.
acceptance_criteria: Only approved phrase is visible
Text remains readable in a small preview
Subject and text do not compete

packs.title: Product cutout with clean edge control
packs.prompt: Create a clean transparent-background cutout from the supplied product image. Preserve the full product shape, label, material texture, and natural edge detail. Remove the environment, props, cast shadow, and reflections outside the product. Do not recreate or alter packaging text. Return one centered asset with generous transparent padding for use in presentations and layouts.
acceptance_criteria: Background is transparent
Edge is clean without haloing
Product labels and proportions remain intact

packs.title: Presentation sticker system
packs.prompt: Create a transparent-background sticker-style illustration of [concept] for [brand]. Use [visual metaphor] with crisp edges, limited [brand palette], and no text. Make the symbol immediately readable at small size and suitable for a presentation, social overlay, or landing page. Avoid logos, copyrighted characters, gradients that become muddy on dark surfaces, and background scenery.
acceptance_criteria: Asset reads at small size
Background is fully transparent
No unrequested text or branding appears

packs.title: Annotated product feature explainer
packs.prompt: Create a clean product feature explainer for [product]. Show one hero product at [view] with exactly [number] numbered callout markers. Use this approved label list only: [approved labels]. Arrange callouts so each leader line ends at the correct feature and no labels overlap. Use [background treatment] and reserve a footer area for later legal copy. A human reviewer must verify factual feature placement and all text before publishing.
acceptance_criteria: Every callout points to the intended feature
Approved labels are complete and legible
Feature claims receive human factual review

packs.title: Training process visual
packs.prompt: Design a 16:9 training process visual for [process name]. Show this exact sequence: [approved steps]. Use a left-to-right flow with one visual anchor per step, restrained [brand palette], and a clear completion state. Do not add, reorder, rename, or imply steps beyond the approved sequence. A subject-matter expert must validate process accuracy before use.
acceptance_criteria: Step order matches approved source
Labels are readable and non-overlapping
No unsupported process claims appear

packs.title: Cross-channel product launch direction
packs.prompt: Create the master art direction for a [brand] launch of [product]. Establish one hero visual, [mood], [lighting], and [composition rule] that can scale across 16:9, 4:5, 1:1, and 9:16 formats. Keep [product identity details] fixed. Describe the visual system as a clean campaign key art, not a collage. Leave safe negative space that can move with each channel crop.
acceptance_criteria: Visual system is adaptable across specified channels
Product identity stays consistent
Composition contains intentional copy-safe space

packs.title: Thought-leadership visual series
packs.prompt: Create a reusable editorial visual direction for a [number]-post thought-leadership series about [topic] for [brand]. Define a stable visual grammar using [hero motif], [surface or texture], [lighting], and [accent color]. Each image should vary the scenario while preserving the same lens language, tonal range, and copy-safe region. Avoid generic AI gradients, floating interface mockups, and fabricated data visualizations.
acceptance_criteria: Series has a recognizable shared visual grammar
Each output has distinct subject matter
No invented data or unverified claims appear

packs.title: Sunburst protected-product scene edit
packs.prompt: Edit the supplied product image. Treat it as the source of truth for product geometry, label placement, material finish, camera angle, and contact shadow. Replace only the environment with [new environment], matching the existing light direction and color temperature. Do not change the product, crop, packaging text, logo placement, or add props, people, or extra products.
acceptance_criteria: Product geometry, label placement, and material finish remain intact
Only the environment changes
New background perspective and contact shadow are coherent

packs.title: Flare channel-ready campaign concept
packs.prompt: Create a [aspect ratio] campaign visual for [brand] and [product]. Establish one clear hero product, [mood], [lighting], and [environment]. Preserve a clean [copy-safe location] for final copy. Use [brand palette] sparingly and do not show readable text, prices, badges, watermarks, interface fragments, or unapproved logos. Produce a single focused key visual, not a collage.
acceptance_criteria: Hero product is immediately recognizable
Copy-safe area is clean and intentional
No fabricated copy, claims, or unapproved branding appears

packs.title: Role-bound visual style transfer
packs.prompt: Use the first supplied reference only for [style role: palette, texture, or visual medium]. Use the second supplied reference only for [identity role: product or subject details]. Create a new [new subject or scene] with [composition]. Preserve the protected identity details from the second reference. Do not reproduce source text, logos, copyrighted characters, or unrelated people from either reference.
variables: style role: palette, texture, or visual medium
identity role: product or subject details
acceptance_criteria: Each reference is used only for its declared role
Protected identity details remain intact
Output is a new composition rather than a copy of either input

packs.title: Verified-copy launch tile
packs.prompt: Create a 4:5 editorial launch tile for [brand]. Show this exact approved copy once, character for character: [approved copy]. Set it in [type treatment] at [placement]. Use [visual subject] as supporting imagery and reserve [accent color] for a small emphasis. Maintain generous margins and high contrast. Do not add any other words, logos, watermarks, dates, claims, or pseudo-text. A human reviewer will verify copy, legibility, and alignment before release.
acceptance_criteria: All visible text exactly matches the approved copy
Text is legible at mobile size
No extra text, pseudo-text, or unapproved claim appears

packs.title: Sunburst transparent product extraction
packs.prompt: Edit the supplied product photo into one clean isolated asset. Preserve product geometry, label legibility, material texture, and natural edge details. Remove only the environment, props, exterior reflections, and cast shadow. Do not recreate or restyle the product. Return a centered product with generous transparent padding, clean alpha edges, no haloing, no painted backdrop, no checkerboard, and no watermark.
acceptance_criteria: Output contains true alpha transparency
Edges are clean without halos or background residue
Product geometry and labels remain intact

packs.title: One-change-at-a-time campaign refinement
packs.prompt: Use the previous approved image as the starting point. Change only [one requested condition]. Keep the product or subject identity, composition, crop, perspective, lighting direction, palette, visible text, and all approved elements unchanged. Do not introduce additional concepts, props, people, or copy. Return one refined image for human comparison against the prior version.
acceptance_criteria: Only the requested condition changes
Protected details match the prior approved image
Human reviewer can compare the new output directly to the prior version

packs.title: Website hero with copy space
packs.prompt:
Copy this brief, complete every bracket, and attach every reference image mentioned. If a required reference is missing or instructions conflict, identify the gap before producing the image.

1. Objective
Image type: website hero.
Purpose and platform: [offer or service] on [landing page].
Core visual idea: [single customer benefit expressed visually].
Target audience: [specific viewer and intended response].

2. References
Reference 1: [filename or None]. Use: [exact role and details to preserve].
Reference 2: [filename or None]. Use: [separate role, such as composition or lighting only].
Priority: [source to follow if references conflict]. Do not transfer unrelated faces, text or logos between references.

3. Art Direction
Subject or product: [hero subject, visible attributes and one supporting object].
Scene and background: [simple architectural or studio setting]. Keep competing objects out of the copy zone.
Composition: Place the subject in [left or right third]; reserve [percentage and side] as low-detail negative space for later headline placement. Protect [mobile crop focal point].
Action and expression: [quiet purposeful action or still pose].
Visual style: [restrained editorial style].
Color and lighting: [palette], [key-light direction], soft controlled shadows; no bright hotspot in the copy area.
Camera direction: [wide or normal lens feel], level viewpoint, moderate depth; keep the subject recognizable in a smaller crop. Camera terms describe the visual result, not guaranteed physical capture metadata.

4. Brand and Continuity Lock
Brand elements to preserve: [palette, materials, mood and approved logo-safe area].
Subject or product invariants: [visible traits, proportions, label details or scene elements that must remain consistent]. Do not claim an exact identity match based on prompting alone.

5. Constraints
Must include: [required elements and priority order].
Must avoid: unrequested people, duplicate objects, malformed anatomy, watermarks, invented logos and [scene-specific exclusions]. Preserve approved details; flag a conflict rather than silently substituting them.

6. Output and Finishing
Image engine: [engine or unspecified].
Aspect ratio and resolution: [desired ratio and pixel dimensions; verify engine support; if unsupported, state an alternative]. Suggested composition: 16:9.
Text in image: No text. Headline and approved logo will be added later.
Finishing requirements: [retouching level, natural surface detail, grain, sharpness and export format].
Later edits I will make: [crop, headline, approved logo, color adjustment or None].
Review before approval: Preserve space for headline across desktop and mobile crops.

separate role, such as composition or lighting only

quiet purposeful action or still pose
palette, materials, mood and approved logo-safe area

desired ratio and pixel dimensions; verify engine support; if unsupported, state an alternative
retouching level, natural surface detail, grain, sharpness and export format

References influence only their assigned roles
All requested invariants and exclusions have been visually inspected
Final crop, copy space and any supplied text are reviewed at delivery size
tips: Design the mobile composition separately if cropping removes the subject or copy zone.
